title: Landing Site
description: Build a responsive landing page with hero, features, pricing, and call-to-action sections.
prompt: Build a responsive landing page for a SaaS product called 'TaskFlow'. Include a hero section with a headline and subheadline, a features grid with icons, a pricing table with three tiers, and a call-to-action section. Use a modern, minimal design with a primary color of indigo and ensure it looks great on mobile and desktop.
